verdict.rationale: Workspace documents Apps Script as its own web-based, low-code environment that anyone can use to automate Admin console tasks. It also documents automatic user provisioning that syncs account changes to third-party apps without manual action. However, nothing shows user-defined automations being scheduled or triggered to run unattended, and nothing shows AI-driven agentic background automation. Missing for 10: documented time- or event-based triggers or recurring schedules for automations, evidence of autonomous background execution beyond the narrow provisioning sync, AI or agentic automation features, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Anyone can use Apps Script to automate Admin console tasks in a web-based, low-code environment.
Puedes configurar el aprovisionamiento automático de usuarios para que los cambios que realices en las cuentas de usuario de Google Workspace se sincronicen automáticamente con esta app de terceros.
